title: ‘For You Fest’ Unveils Inaugural Lineup Featuring Sets From Your Favorite Podcasters, Influencers & Musicians
summary: Social media stars such as Trisha Paytas, Tana Mongeau, Drew Afualo and more are on the bill.
contentText:
For You Fest is turning the feed you scroll through into a festival you can stroll through, announcing this week that its inaugural event will take place in November with programs led by social-media stars such as Quenlin Blackwell, Tana Mongeau, Trixie Mattel, Trisha Paytas, Drew Afualo, Caleb Hearon, Meg Stalter and more.

Kicking off Saturday, Nov. 14, at Great Park in Irvine, Calif., the two-day festival will open with a live taping of Superfans , a new podcast hosted by Billboard executive editor Lyndsey Havens, featuring fans and a surprise guest. That’s one of several in-person recordings coming to the podcast stage, which itself is one of three main divisions of the event. There will also be a music stage as well as a fashion and beauty stage, plus dedicated areas for meet-and-greets and various workshops on the grounds that attendees can add on to their tickets.

Blackwell and Owen Thiele are two more of the podcasters lined up for the first day of the festival, while Afualo and Hearon, Tana Mongeau, Stalter and more will bring their pods to the festival on day two, which is Nov. 15. Mattell, Paytas, Rebecca Black, Absolutely and others will perform on the music stage over the course of the weekend, while Chappell Roan collaborator Ramisha Sattar and makeup artist Patrick Ta are locked in to lead some of the many fashion and beauty offerings over the weekend.

Beyond the live installations, guests will be able to explore the For You Fest Trend Market — featuring a selection of the buzziest current brands to sample and shop — as well as dine and drink at the Food & Bev Village.

Tickets for the festival first became available in a presale on Friday (July 10), featuring options such as general admission for one or both days, pit viewing and VIP, plus “Bestie” and suite packages. Anyone can now purchase the remaining tickets on the For You Fest website .
